meaning: Derives the #166 first-being bridge through the quarta via: the maximal being is first, since what is simply prior is more in being (Metaphysics II.1), and every first mover moved by none is the maximal being. The Comparator config also verifies withoutAppliedAgentNotFirstBeing (without the q.105 a.5 premise an unmoved mover caused in its being, like an Aristotelian intelligence, is not first), withoutPriorMoreNotFirstBeing (without the Metaphysics II premise a maximal being can have something simply prior to it), and premisesJointlySatisfiable (all premises of the #147 results, the prima via premises and act's simple priority hold in one finite model with a caused agent that moves and is moved).
